_comment: Where the inputs that are too large or too restricted to commit actually live.
Scripts resolve a source through fdqbench.paths.resolve_source(name), which
checks, in order: the --<name> command-line argument, the FDQ_<NAME>
environment variable, then this file. No script may carry a personal
Paths may be absolute or relative to the repository root, and may use ~.
Copy this file to data_sources.local.json to override it without a diff;
the local file is gitignored and takes precedence.

link_queue_simulation.description: Shared NVTA package: INRIX 15-minute TMC speeds, the TMC-to-link matching table, and the TAPLite assignment link_performance tables. Needed by queue steps 1 and 5 only; steps 2-4 and 6-8 run from committed outputs.

pems_i405_raw.description: PeMS I-405 South detector states used by the multiweek average-weekday holdout.
